fields.title: ARCE (Uruguay) tender/purchase record
fields.description: One record per Uruguay ARCE release event (mode=list, one row per RSS entry, optionally enriched with full merged detail) or per purchase (mode=detail, one specific idCompra's full merged tender/buyer/award record). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a record can't be fetched.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: For list records: 'list:idCompra=<id>'. For detail records: the idCompra that was requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which strategy emitted this record (S1-ocds-rss, S1-record-plus-followed-releases, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records (blocked_or_transient, not_found).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_detailError.title: Detail enrichment error
_detailError.description: Present only on a list-mode row when fetchDetail=true and that row's own detail fetch failed -- the rest of the row's list fields are still valid.

idCompra.title: Purchase ID
idCompra.description: ARCE's own internal purchase identifier -- stable across a purchase's whole lifecycle (tender -> amendments -> award).

releaseId.title: Release ID
releaseId.description: The specific release event's identifier, e.g. 'llamado-1314718', 'adjudicacion-1367020' (list rows only).

eventType.title: Event type
eventType.description: The RSS feed's own event category: tender, tenderUpdate, tenderAmendment, tenderCancellation, award, or awardUpdate (list rows only).

pubDate.title: Published date
pubDate.description: This release event's publish date/time, as shown in the RSS feed (list rows only).

releaseUrl.title: Release URL
releaseUrl.description: Direct link to this specific release event's full JSON (list rows only).

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: The RSS item's guid, same as releaseId (list rows only).

ocid.title: OCID
ocid.description: The Open Contracting ID for this purchase, e.g. ocds-yfs5dr-1314718. Only present once a real release has actually been fetched (detail records, or list rows with fetchDetail=true) -- never fabricated on a bare list row.

buyerId.title: Buyer ID
buyerId.description: The purchasing government institution's ARCE identifier.

tenderId.title: Tender ID
tenderId.description: The buyer's own tender reference number, when a tender release exists for this purchase.

tenderTitle.title: Tender title
tenderTitle.description: The tender's title or description, e.g. 'Concurso de Precios 6870/2026'.

procurementMethodDetails.title: Procurement method details
procurementMethodDetails.description: Spanish-language procurement modality, e.g. 'Concurso de Precios', 'Compra Directa', 'Licitacion Publica'.

tenderStartDate.title: Tender start date
tenderStartDate.description: The tender period's start date, when present.

tenderEndDate.title: Tender end date (bid opening)
tenderEndDate.description: The tender period's end date (bid submission/opening deadline), when present.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Union of OCDS release tags seen across this purchase's followed release links (e.g. ['tender', 'award']).

awardsCount.title: Awards count
awardsCount.description: Number of award entries across this purchase's followed release links.

totalAwardAmount.title: Total award amount
totalAwardAmount.description: This actor's own sum of (unit price * quantity) across every awarded line item seen -- ARCE's award releases carry price only per line item, with no upstream award-level total.

awardCurrency.title: Award currency
awardCurrency.description: Currency code for totalAwardAmount, e.g. UYU (Uruguayan peso).

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Names of all winning suppliers across this purchase's awards.

latestReleaseDate.title: Latest release date
latestReleaseDate.description: The date of the most recent followed release for this purchase.

releaseLinks.title: Release links (raw)
releaseLinks.description: The upstream record endpoint's own list of {url, date, tag} references that were followed to build this detail record -- present on detail records and list rows fetched with fetchDetail=true.

releases.title: Release history (full detail)
releases.description: The complete followed release objects, verbatim, one entry per tender/amendment/award/awardUpdate event -- present on detail records and list rows fetched with fetchDetail=true.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across list and detail records -- rows missing a given column render blank.
